observations: body L2: the 3 is printed with the initial form of jīm, first without its dot, then with it («aut»); transcribed with a zero-width joiner.
body L12: the sigla of Heiberg's codices are printed «μ» with a small ε above it and «ἐλ» with a raised ς; «recipiens» is printed with the e broken.
body L16: «τόν» is printed so, with an acute accent.
notes_left L8: «A D. 1218» is printed without a period after A.
notes_left L20: a blot is printed over the d of «denuo».

notes_left L22: the last line of the column is printed with the type displaced: the a of «a Ptolemaeo», the e of «Ptolemaeo» and the first i of «indicatas» raised, «emenda» with the d raised and the a lowered, without a hyphen; the word continues «tiones» at the head of the right column.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
